a.device_id , a.device_code , a.device_name , a.alias_name , a.device_type , a.position_type , a.model_id , a.region_path , a.up_region_id , a.custom_type , a.status , a.update_time , a.create_time , a.preset_id, a.camera_id, b.device_model, b.used_time, b.pms_type, b.pms_id, b.device_vendor, b.production_date , b.disable_date, b.last_maintenance, b.maintenance_count, b.organization, b.department, b.responsible_person, b.latitude, b.longitude, b.ip, b.port, b.voltage_Level, b.sequence_point , a.real_code , b.address
mapper.insert: insert into t_std_device( device_id, device_code, device_name, alias_name, device_type, position_type, model_id, region_path, up_region_id, up_region_name, custom_type, status, update_time, create_time, preset_id, camera_id )values( #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{deviceCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aliasName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{positionType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{regionPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{upRegionId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{upRegionName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{customType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{status, jdbcType=INTEGER}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{presetId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT} )
mapper.delete: delete from t_std_device where device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.update:
update t_std_device a a.device_id = #{deviceId}, a.device_code = #{deviceCode}, a.device_name = #{deviceName}, a.alias_name = #{aliasName}, a.device_type = #{deviceType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.position_type = #{positionType}, a.model_id = #{modelId}, a.region_path = #{regionPath}, a.up_region_id = #{upRegionId}, a.up_region_name = #{upRegionName}, a.custom_type = #{customType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.status = #{status, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.preset_id = #{presetId}, a.camera_id = #{cameraId}, a.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), a.real_code = #{realCode},
where a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

UPDATE t_std_device SET real_code = ( SELECT a.person_check FROM u_patrol_data_result a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance b ON a.instance_id = b.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete c ON b.device_mete_id = c.device_mete_id WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND c.analyse_type = 8 AND ( person_check REGEXP '[^0-9.]' ) = 0 ) WHERE device_id = ( SELECT DISTINCT a.device_id FROM u_patrol_data_result a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance b ON a.instance_id = b.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete c ON b.device_mete_id = c.device_mete_id WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND c.analyse_type = 8 AND ( person_check REGEXP '[^0-9.]' ) = 0 )
mapper.select: select a.device_id, a.device_code, a.device_name, a.alias_name, a.device_type, a.position_type, a.model_id, a.region_path, a.up_region_id, a.up_region_name, a.custom_type, a.status, a.update_time, a.create_time, a.preset_id, a.camera_id from t_std_device a where 1 = 1 and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

select a.device_id, a.device_code, a.device_name, a.alias_name, a.device_type, a.position_type, a.model_id, a.region_path, a.up_region_id, a.up_region_name, a.custom_type, a.status, a.update_time, a.create_time, a.preset_id, a.camera_id from t_std_device a where 1 = 1 and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

select a.device_id , a.device_code , a.device_name , a.alias_name , a.device_type , h.dict_note as deviceTypeName, a.position_type , a.model_id , a.region_path , a.up_region_id , a.up_region_name , a.custom_type , a.status , a.update_time , a.create_time , a.preset_id, a.camera_id, b.device_model, e.dict_note as deviceModelName, b.pms_type, b.pms_id, b.device_vendor, f.dict_note deviceVendorName, b.production_date , b.used_time, b.disable_date, b.last_maintenance, b.maintenance_count, b.organization, b.department, b.responsible_person, b.latitude, b.longitude, b.ip, b.port, b.voltage_Level, g.dict_note as voltageLevelName, b.sequence_point , a.real_code , b.address, d.model_name as modelName from t_std_device a,t_std_device_attr b,t_std_metemodel d,t_dict_business e,t_dict_business f,t_dict_business g,t_dict_business h where 1 = 1 and a.device_id = b.device_id and d.model_id=a.model_id and b.device_model = e.dict_code and b.device_vendor=f.dict_code and b.voltage_level=g.dict_code and h.dict_code = a.device_type and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

select a.device_id, a.device_code, a.device_name, a.alias_name, a.device_type, a.position_type, a.model_id, a.region_path, a.up_region_id, a.up_region_name, a.custom_type, a.status, a.update_time, a.create_time, a.preset_id, a.camera_id from t_std_device a where a.device_id=#{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

select a.device_id from t_std_device a where 1=1 and a.device_name like concat('%',#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.device_type like concat('%', #{deviceType, jdbcType=INTEGER},'%') and a.real_code like concat('%', #{realCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
and a.up_region_id in
#{upRegionIds,jdbcType=BIGINT}
group by a.device_id order by a.device_id desc

select DISTINCT a.device_id, b.region_id, b.region_name, b.sort, b.up_region_id, b.up_region_ids, b.region_code, b.station_id, b.state, b.create_time from t_std_device a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id where 1 = 1 and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT c.custom_id AS Id, c.custom_name AS label, c.device_id AS upId, e.device_name AS upName, "custom" AS infoType FROM t_std_devicemete c LEFT JOIN t_std_device e ON c.device_id = e.device_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType, "" AS deviceTypeId FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id where 1 = 1 and a.region_id =#{regionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType, b.device_type AS deviceTypeId FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id where 1 = 1 and b.up_region_id =#{regionId, jdbcType=BIGINT});

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT c.custom_id AS Id, c.custom_name AS label, c.device_id AS upId, e.device_name AS upName, "custom" AS infoType FROM t_std_devicemete c LEFT JOIN t_std_device e ON c.device_id = e.device_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT d.camera_id AS Id, d.camera_name AS label, d.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info d LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON d.up_region_id = b.region_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT d.camera_id AS Id, d.camera_name AS label, d.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info d LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON d.up_region_id = b.region_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.robot_id AS Id, b.robot_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "robot" AS infoType FROM t_robot_info b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT c.robot_id AS Id, c.robot_name AS label, c.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "robot" AS infoType FROM t_robot_info c LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON c.up_region_id = d.region_id) union all ( select e.inspection_id as Id, e.inspection_name as label, f.robot_id as upId, f.robot_name as upName, "inspection" as infoType from t_robot_inspection e left join t_robot_info f on f.robot_id = e.robot_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT d.camera_id AS Id, d.camera_name AS label, d.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info d LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON d.up_region_id = b.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.robot_id AS Id, b.robot_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "robot" AS infoType FROM t_robot_info b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT e.inspection_id AS Id, e.inspection_name AS label, f.robot_id AS upId, f.robot_name AS upName, "inspection" AS infoType FROM t_robot_inspection e LEFT JOIN t_robot_info f ON f.robot_id = e.robot_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT e.preset_id AS Id, e.preset_name AS label, f.camera_id AS upId, f.camera_name AS upName, "preset" AS infoType FROM t_camera_preset e LEFT JOIN t_camera_info f ON f.camera_id = e.camera_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT dm.device_mete_id AS Id, dm.mete_name AS label, dm.device_id AS upId, sd.device_name AS upName,"devicemete" AS infoType FROM t_std_devicemete dm LEFT JOIN t_std_device sd ON sd.device_id = dm.device_id where 1=1 and dm.mete_type = #{deviceType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dm.analyse_type = #{analyseType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT cpi.instance_id AS Id,cpi.cruise_name AS label,cpi.device_mete_id AS upId,dm.mete_name AS upName, (case when cpi.cruise_type = 228 then "robotCruiseInspection" when cpi.cruise_type = 229 then "videoCruiseInspection" when cpi.cruise_type = 230 then "videoCruiseInspection" END) AS infoType FROM t_cruise_point_instance cpi LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete dm ON dm.device_mete_id = cpi.device_mete_id where 1=1 and dm.mete_type = #{deviceType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dm.analyse_type = #{analyseType, jdbcType=VARCHAR});

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT dm.device_mete_id AS Id, dm.mete_name AS label, dm.device_id AS upId, sd.device_name AS upName,"devicemete" AS infoType FROM t_std_devicemete dm LEFT JOIN t_std_device sd ON sd.device_id = dm.device_id where 1=1 and dm.mete_type = #{deviceType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dm.analyse_type = #{analyseType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) UNION ALL ( SELECT cpi.instance_id AS Id,cpi.cruise_name AS label,cpi.device_mete_id AS upId,dm.mete_name AS upName, (case when cpi.cruise_type = 228 then "robotCruiseInspection" when cpi.cruise_type = 229 then "videoCruiseInspection" when cpi.cruise_type = 230 then "videoCruiseInspection" END) AS infoType FROM t_cruise_point_instance cpi LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete dm ON dm.device_mete_id = cpi.device_mete_id where cpi.cruise_type = 228 and dm.mete_type = #{deviceType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dm.analyse_type = #{analyseType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} );

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT dm.device_mete_id AS Id, dm.mete_name AS label, dm.device_id AS upId, sd.device_name AS upName,"devicemete" AS infoType FROM t_std_devicemete dm LEFT JOIN t_std_device sd ON sd.device_id = dm.device_id where 1=1 and dm.mete_type = #{deviceType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dm.analyse_type = #{analyseType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) UNION ALL ( SELECT cpi.instance_id AS Id,cpi.cruise_name AS label,cpi.device_mete_id AS upId,dm.mete_name AS upName, (case when cpi.cruise_type = 228 then "robotCruiseInspection" when cpi.cruise_type = 229 then "videoCruiseInspection" when cpi.cruise_type = 230 then "videoCruiseInspection" END) AS infoType FROM t_cruise_point_instance cpi LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete dm ON dm.device_mete_id = cpi.device_mete_id where cpi.cruise_type = 229 and dm.mete_type = #{deviceType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dm.analyse_type = #{analyseType, jdbcType=VARCHAR});

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task_attr e ON e.device_id = b.device_id WHERE 1 = 1 and e.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT c.custom_id AS Id, c.custom_name AS label, c.device_id AS upId, e.device_name AS upName, "custom" AS infoType FROM t_std_devicemete c LEFT JOIN t_std_device e ON c.device_id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task_attr f ON f.device_mete_id = c.device_mete_id WHERE 1 = 1 and f.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT dict_code AS customType, dict_note AS customTypeName FROM t_dict_business WHERE col_name = "custom_type"

SELECT DISTINCT b.up_region_name AS 'deviceRegion', b.device_name, b.device_code, c.dict_note AS 'deviceTypeName', a.custom_name, ( SELECT count(*) FROM t_std_devicemete d
WHERE d.device_id = a.device_id ) AS 'meteCounts' FROM t_std_devicemete a LEFT JOIN t_std_device b ON a.device_id = b.device_id AND a.device_id = b.device_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business c ON b.device_type = c.dict_code WHERE a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.mete_name AS 'deviceMeteName', b.dict_note AS 'meteTypeName', ( SELECT count(*) FROM t_std_devicemete c LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance d ON c.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id WHERE c.device_mete_id = a.device_mete_id ) AS 'cruiseCounts' FROM t_std_devicemete a LEFT JOIN t_dict_business b ON a.mete_type = b.dict_code WHERE a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
